full_page.content:
1953, August 6
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Blessed be God! In all His designs.
August 6th '53
Mr. Wallace V.E.Bedolfe 27 White Oak Blv'd Toronto, Canada.
God bless you Wally and multiply His graces and joys in your soul!
I surely congratulate you the privileged step you had on the 49th anniversary of my first Holy Mass, Feast of St. Ignatius. Glory be to God! I should surely like to have been there. I am sure Father Edward will be pleased to hear of your progress. But its only when we shall actually reached Heaven that we'll be in contition to ap- preciate the real meaning of heavenly joys. Because as St. Paul assures in his letter to the Romans: "Eye hath not seen, Ear hath not heard, nor hath it entered into the heart of man to conceive what God hath prepared for them that love Him." ...... something like Fr. E'd concludes one of his poems; his "Valley of Plains" (in Montana)
"0 God! What the glory of Heaven must be! when its feeble Reflection on Mountain and lea, Enrobes the dull clay in a beauty sublime! -- Eternity's breath -- on the ashes of time."
Best wishes and God's blessing to all. Praised be Jesus Christ! Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
P.S. An old adage: "Finis Coronet Opus" "The end crowns the work."
